Context: 7. Calculation of Pension

| Age of Pensioner | Age of Pensioner | Additional Pension / Additional Compassionate Allowance |
| ----------------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| 80 years to less than | 85 years | 20% of Basic Pension / Compassionate Allowance |
| 85 years to less than | 90 years | 30% of Basic Pension/ Compassionate Allowance |
| 90 years to less than | 95 years | 40% of Basic Pension / Compassionate Allowance |
